verdict.rationale: Helicone's pricing page calls the product open-source, its llms.txt is titled 'Helicone OSS', and the source is published at github.com/Helicone/helicone with documented self-hosting. A community report concretely contradicts the 'open license' claim: it says Helicone shipped under the Commons Clause, which is not generally considered an open-source license, and that this was raised on GitHub. That report may predate the current license. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the current license (e.g. OSI-approved Apache/MIT), independent confirmation that the Commons Clause restriction was removed.
